growth_calibration.evaluation_reference: ScenarioResult independent end-session measured RMS increase; used only for session-level Validation scoring and never to label past samples

high_roll_calibration.reference_definition: S0/S0b background and post-transition S1/H1 exposure strata; scenario/event metadata only defines diagnostic cohorts, not labels

limitations: Synthetic G1 pilot does not establish real-vessel performance.
All thresholds remain candidate pending human review and group approval.
Exposure strata are diagnostic context, not absolute movement labels.
Pilot window rates are descriptive because adjacent windows overlap.
No Test-G1/Test-G2 sessions or official 605-session dataset were used.
